data.name: Sheraton Porto Hotel & Spa
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodations
The Sheraton Porto Hotel & Spa offers spacious guest rooms beautifully designed with a mix of wood, steel, and glass. Each room features a minibar, seating area, and bathtub, providing guests with a comfortable and stylish retreat during their stay.

Relaxation and Wellness
Unwind completely at the hotel's modern spa, which boasts 8 treatment rooms, an indoor pool, a yoga studio, various classes, a relaxation area, and a juice bar. Whether guests seek a rejuvenating massage or a refreshing swim, the spa offers a serene environment to relax and rejuvenate.

Culinary Delights and Entertainment
Indulge in traditional Portuguese cuisine at the on-site restaurant and savor a glass of wine to complement your meal. After dinner, guests can enjoy live music at the piano bar in the hotel lobby, offering picturesque views of the garden. Additionally, free Wi-Fi access on the SL floor ensures connectivity throughout your stay.

Experience luxury, relaxation, and culinary delights at the Sheraton Porto Hotel & Spa. Book now for an unforgettable stay!
data.hotelImportantInformation:
Please note that the hotel may charge an extra fee for access to the SPA, as this facility is not included in all rates.

Please note that childrens' access to the pool is available everyday from 13:00 to 19:00.
A deposit may be required at the property.
